items.summary: Recommendation: approve containment-only execution and reject new spend, forecasts, commitments, monetization expansion, telemetry, deployments, requeues, and unsupported revenue claims. Revenue evidence covers 2026-09-21 only: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission. The commission is not site-attributable; site-attributed commission of $0 does not prove zero site performance. AI usage covers 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-28: 4,926 calls and $901.90 cost, including 228 errors and 5 transient errors. Contribution margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, infrastructure spend, and budget exposure are not calculable because revenue and cost periods do not align, infrastructure/domain/labor/marketing/experiment costs are incomplete, monthly budget ceilings are blank, and no learning-outcome threshold exists. The pilot’s 70 treatment outputs versus 44 controls is operational activity, not financial or causal evidence. Continue only the existing period-aligned revenue, attribution, cost reconciliation, repair-or-close, measurement, legal, and security work. Minimum finance evidence before reconsidering growth: attributable revenue by site/content/tracking identifier for the same period as a complete reconciled cost ledger, approved budget ceilings, and a defined learning outcome with a maximum cost-to-learn.

Handoff: continue the existing revenue, attribution, and cost reconciliation work only. Retain the $4.92 provider aggregate as unattributed; do not treat clicks, orders, shipped items, sessions, conversions, AI calls, or pilot output counts as financial performance. Do not create duplicate telemetry or finance work.
